# `time_from_micros`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
time_from_micros(micros)
```

Creates a TIME value from microseconds since midnight.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- time_from_micros, example 1
> SELECT time_from_micros(0);
00:00:00
```

```sql
-- time_from_micros, example 2
> SELECT time_from_micros(52200000000);
14:30:00
```

```sql
-- time_from_micros, example 3
> SELECT time_from_micros(52200500000);
14:30:00.5
```

```sql
-- time_from_micros, example 4
> SELECT time_from_micros(86399999999);
23:59:59.999999
```
